test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: On 28 March 2022, Minister of Information and Broadcasting of India, Anurag Thakur launched a scheme called TEJAS at Dubai Expo, which is an initiative under the Skill India International Project to train Indians so that they can get employed overseas. What is the full form of TEJAS?

options.text: Training for Eccentric Jobs and Skills
Technology for Emirates Jobs and Skills
Training for Empowering Jobs and Skills
Training for Emirates Jobs and Skills

solution:
The correct answer is __**Training for Emirates Jobs and Skills**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of TEJAS is Training for Emirates Jobs and Skills
 
• Union Minister Shri Anurag Thakur launched TEJAS (Training for Emirates Jobs And Skills), a Skill India International Project to train overseas Indias.
 
• It is a Skill India International Project to train overseas Indians.
 
• The project is aimed at skilling, certification and overseas employment of Indians.
 
• Tejas is aimed at creating pathways to enable the Indian workforce to get equipped for skill and market requirements in UAE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tejas aims at creating a 10,000 strong Indian workforce in UAE during the initial phase.
 
• The Minister also met prominent Indian film personalities like Shri Kabir Khan and Shri Priyadarshan in a discussion also attended by Film Commissioner of the Abu Dhabi Film Commission Mr Hans Fraikin.
 
• Subsequently, Shri Thakur embarked on a visit to the India Pavillion at Dubai Expo where he also held a discussion with the Minister of State for International Cooperation in the Government of UAE, Ms Reem Al Hashimi.
